topic: Screen-share-safe mode does not cover the menu bar panel
detail: SP-051's screen-share-safe mode (D-21) hides every pane but Spaces in the main window, disables the command palette and stops notifications, but the menu bar panel (TrayMenu.swift, outside SP-051's files) still lists every space's PRs and needs-you items when opened. Proposed: while SpacesOverviewModel.shareSafe is set, the panel shows only the enforcement banner and a 'Sharing only <space>' line, or filters PRs by owner using ListSpaces' github_orgs.
